items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Formal service (Zustellungsurkunde, §182 ZPO) shows the notice was delivered on 23.11.2026 (Monday) — this is documented proof of delivery, so the delivery date is certain. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB, the day of the triggering event (23.11.2026) is not counted; the period starts the next day (24.11.2026). As a 2-week period under §188 Abs.2 BGB, it ends with the expiry of the day in the second week that bears the same name as the day of the event (Monday) — i.e. two weeks after 23.11.2026 = 07.12.2026 (Monday). 07.12.2026 is a regular weekday in Niedersachsen (no public holiday), so §193 BGB extension does not apply.

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and delivery costs (total)
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: Assuming no Einspruch is filed, the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) upon expiry of the Einspruch period on 07.12.2026, i.e. as of 08.12.2026 (Tuesday). Treating 08.12.2026 as the triggering event, under §187 Abs.1 BGB that day is not counted; the 2-week period runs and, per §188 Abs.2 BGB, ends with the day in the second week corresponding by name to the event day (Tuesday) — two weeks after 08.12.2026 = 22.12.2026 (Tuesday). 22.12.2026 is a normal working day in Niedersachsen, so no §193 BGB extension applies. This date is contingent on no Einspruch being filed; if an Einspruch is submitted, the fine is not yet due and this date no longer applies.

warnings: The payment due date (22.12.2026) is only valid if no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026; if an objection is lodged within the deadline, the fine is suspended and this payment date does not apply.

The letter and the attached delivery slip both bear handwritten/template elements ('Ha.', the delivery date entry) — double-check against your own copy of the Zustellungsurkunde that 23.11.2026 is indeed the date the postal carrier recorded as the delivery date, since the whole Einspruch deadline depends on it.
